purpose: Make the local database and migration path executable before product tables and routes are implemented.
success_outcome: Feature tasks can add migrations and DB-backed services without redefining local database setup or readiness behavior.
anti_goals: No hosted database or cloud sync.

forbidden_scope: server sync or hosted database assumptions

success_checks: Local PostgreSQL init script creates or verifies database/user for DATABASE_URL idempotently.
Migration command path can run and report status against configured local PostgreSQL.
/ready proves DB connectivity when DB readiness is enabled.
Rollback-safe test session remains available for feature tests.
evidence_required: DB init/migration transcript or safe local dry-run evidence

stop_conditions: Local PostgreSQL bootstrap cannot be made idempotent.
Migration command would require destructive database operations.
Readiness behavior would leak credentials or protected details.
